source_findings.finding: Both unpatched sources compare whole structures after projection-index matching. Local68d has no lazy_delta_proj_reduction helper. The patch instead adds lazy unfolding followed by comparison of projected fields.
Both sources return a two-valued bool and continue into lazy_delta_step after false. The patch returns Option<bool> and stops also on Some(false). Local68d lacks this change.
Both sources normalize inside reduce_proj and unwrap the selected constructor argument. Local68d has no separate reduce_proj_core. The patch separates extraction and removes the unwrap.

applicability.conclusion: The two source-level mechanisms are present in our pinned checker; their relevance is not confined to the external fork. Neither equivalent fix is already present.
